approved_sources.description: Made-up arrest records for testing. Describes no real person or event and says nothing about Montgomery County.

metric_definitions.name: arrest_count
metric_definitions.meaning: the number of rows (arrest records) in the period

skills.name: arrest_count_trend
skills.description: Count arrest records per calendar month of one year, for all ages or one age group.

arguments.age_group: one of under_18, 18_25, 26_40, 41_plus, or null for all ages

skills.name: compare_counts
skills.description: Compare two to eight counts of arrest records: which is highest, which is lowest, and the difference between the highest and the lowest. No rate and no percentage.

arguments.result_ids: two to eight counts made in the same turn
